SPRING 2027 / COURSE

Dreamwork Workshop with Michel Claeys

Starting from dream elements, learn to understand and translate.

dreamwork · Special Topic

Course at a Glance

Starting from the dreamer's own experience, learn to understand the characters, scenes and emotions in the dream, and use dreams as material to explore the inner space.

Who is suitable to study

Learners who are interested in the understanding of dreams and dreamwork, as well as partners who want to bring dreams into personal growth or professional learning.

What to learn in the course

  • Record your dreams and identify the characters, scenes and emotions in them.
  • Understand and translate dream elements within the context of the dreamer's own life.
  • Explore the connection of dreams to wounded, resourceful inner spaces.

learning style

Starting from the dream brought by the dreamer, combined with explanation, on-site demonstration and group communication, we practice listening to dreams, understanding dream elements, and bringing understanding back to personal experience.

learning objectives

Understand the dreamwork path centered on the dreamer’s experience, and practice exploring inner exploration from dream clues.

What can I learn next?

dreamwork can be cross-referenced with Essence Therapy methods. As you continue learning, you can read The Truth of Dreams (《梦的真相》) or learn about other workshops.
